artworks.title: Supply Train and Mules [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Edmund Louis Gray Zalinski, II
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch on light textured paper of horse-drawn covered wagons. The scene shows a series of wagons extending into the distance. A horse is on the left, and the largest wagon is in the center with detailed wheels and a visible cover. Smaller covered wagons and figures suggest a convoy, receding into the upper right. The sketch uses delicate pencil strokes for a sense of movement. The palette is monochromatic, with soft pencil gray tones against the tan paper.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape with a Watermill
artworks.medium: brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a watermill in the center, water flowing from its wheel. A man is walking on a path to the right. A stream winds through the scene towards hills and a building in the distance. Trees are present throughout, adding texture. The color palette is sepia, emphasizing light and shadow. The sky is softly painted.

artworks.title: Saint Euphrosyne
artworks.artist: Attributed to Melchior Steidl after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and touches of graphite, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Le Claire and Katrin Bellinger
artworks.description: The image displays three figures. The central figure is seated and supported by the other two. The central figure has wavy dark hair, eyes closed, and wears a robe with a cross. The figure on the left looks serene, while the one on the right holds onto the cross. The background is sketchy with dark and light contrast, possibly depicting a dimly lit or nighttime setting with visible wooden beams.

artworks.title: Greeting Grandmother (Le Bonjour à la Grand-mère)
artworks.medium: etching with graphite additions on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image is a room sketch with three figures. In the foreground, a person lies on a bed, while another person stands near the bed, offering a child. A third individual stands by a window, holding the curtains open to let daylight in. The room includes furniture like a tall cabinet and a picture frame. The sketch is done in monochrome with shading for depth.

artworks.title: Greeting Grandmother (Le Bonjour à la Grand-mère)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette with false-biting on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in a room. On the right, a person lies in bed with only their head visible, resting on a pillow. Another person stands next to the bed holding a child. The child is sitting on the person's lap, reaching towards the individual in bed. In the background to the left, a third figure is seen with arms raised, interacting with curtains or a sheet. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like, monochromatic style with detailed cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Greeting Grandmother (Le Bonjour à la Grand-mère)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, false-biting, and softground etching on Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a room interior containing four individuals. In the foreground, an adult is partially seen lying in bed, covered by a blanket and head resting on a pillow. This person is turned slightly on their side with one arm extended upward, reaching out towards a child. The child is held by another adult who is standing next to the bed. The child's features are small and delicate, with short hair. The adult holding them has a muscular build with short hair and facial features depicted in shadow. In the background, there is another person depicted from the back, standing near a window with light streaming through the curtains they are holding open. No explicit details of facial features can be discerned due to the shading and positioning. No visible jewelry is noted, and no objects are held by the individuals. The atmosphere of the room is characterized by a mixture of darkness and light, with the source of light coming from the window, casting the individuals in varied degrees of shadow.

artworks.title: Greeting Grandmother (Le Bonjour à la Grand-mère)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, false-biting, and softground etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with three figures in a dimly lit interior space. On the right side, there is a partially visible person reclining in a bed, seen from the waist up, with long hair cascading over the pillow. On the left, another figure stands with their back mostly to the viewer, holding an infant or small child at chest level, who appears to be reaching out or being handed to the person on the bed. To the left of them, in the background, a third figure is visible, wholly silhouetted, standing in front of a window with their arms extended holding open a curtain, creating a triangular opening of light. The room around them is mostly shadowed, creating a contrast between the brightness coming through the window and the darker, textured bedding and walls.

artworks.title: Greeting Grandmother (Le Bonjour à la Grand-mère)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, false-biting, softground etching, and roulette on Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows two adults and a child in a dimly lit room. One adult, seen from behind, is standing full-length in front of a window, pulling back thick curtains to let light in. The other adult is partially visible, sitting up in bed with most of their upper body and profile shown, passively supporting a child being held by the standing adult. The child is cradled in the arms of the adult nearest them, with detail visible on a small portion of their face and body. The room is monochromatic with soft lighting, enhancing a mellow atmosphere, and features minimal furniture and textures visible beyond the individuals.

artworks.title: Sickness (La Maladie)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with two individuals indoors. The first person is lying in a bed with their upper body slightly elevated against a pillow, reaching out their right hand towards the second person. The second person, standing at the foot of the bed, is extending their left arm holding a small object. The room features simple furnishings like a chair and patterned drapery on the walls. The overall lighting in the room is dim, enhancing the intimate atmosphere.

artworks.title: Misery (La Misère)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on their side on a bed. The person's face is partly facing upwards, with short, dark hair. They are unclothed and covered by a blanket. The room includes a bed with a blanket, a table with items on it, and a textured wall with small bottles or containers on a shelf in the background. The drawing style features cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: Misery (La Misère)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and printed tone on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying in bed, partially covered by a sheet. The person is on their side, head resting on a pillow, with eyes open. Their facial features are softly sketched, and their hair is short and slightly tousled. No specific clothing is visible due to the sheet. The room is dimly lit, with a shelf holding bottles in the background, and a shadowy stool or chair near the bed. The scene is rendered in a monochrome style with intricate hatching.

artworks.title: Social Triumph (Le Triomphe mondain)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and printed tone on laid japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring silhouettes and contrasts. The composition is divided into two sections: the foreground shows silhouetted horse figures with bold lines, while the background depicts interior scenes with ghostly figures in soft, sketch-like textures. A window on the right is defined by a grid of panes, casting a shadow. The use of light and dark suggests a narrative depth and emotional tension. The style is reminiscent of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.

artworks.title: Prostitution (La Prostitution)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an interior setting. One person on the left is partially visible from the waist up, with their hands clasped in front. The person's face is shadowed, and they appear to have long hair or a hat covering their head. The other person on the right is only partially visible, showing their back and a top hat. A mesh-like pattern is around them, and above is a lamp and part of a store sign with the letters "PHAR." The background is heavily shaded.

artworks.title: Intimate Fantasy (Féerie intime)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 36 x 48.4 cm (14 3/16 x 19 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on an armchair. The person is relaxed, with their body slightly turned to the side, one arm on the back of the chair and the other supporting their head. They have delicate facial features, closed eyes, slightly parted lips, and dark, short hair contrasting their pale skin. The person appears unclothed and detailed anatomically. The background includes a dark, textured wall and a visible curtain or drapery, creating depth. The image has a monochromatic tone with deep shadows and areas of lightness emphasizing the person and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Robert Besnard
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing with one hand on his hip and leaning on a structure with his other hand. He has a focused expression, defined eyebrows, and slightly tousled hair. He wears a dark outfit with textured fabric, along with what seems to be tall socks or boots. The background features vertical lines resembling a wood-like wall, with the name "Robert" and a date etched faintly. The image is monochromatic, highlighting the intricate etching details. No jewelry or objects are visible on the boy, except for his interaction with the furniture.

artworks.title: Robert Besnard and His Donkey (Robert Besnard et son ane)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on BFK Rives wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a young child standing next to a donkey. The child has short, straight hair and a rounded face, wearing a dark, long-sleeved garment with a high collar. The child has a slightly serious expression. The donkey's head is detailed, showing its ears, eyes, and muzzle. The background features sketchy lines and shading, suggesting a textured setting, possibly outdoors with foliage or natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Woman Reading in the Studio (La Lecture dans l'atelier)
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a person depicted from the waist up, seated in a relaxed position. The individual's profile faces to the right, displaying a boldly outlined nose and soft facial features. The hair is short and appears to be densely textured. This person wears a loosely fitted garment that drapes over the shoulders and arms. Hands are visible, one resting on the lap and covered slightly by the fabric. In the background, there is a detailed scene of the room, with wooden paneling and furniture, such as a tall chair or stand that occupies the space behind the seated person. The word "Bemist" is discernible in the upper right corner of the background.

artworks.title: Le Port aux Mouettes (Port with Seagulls)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint and sandpaper ground in brown-black and black ink with white chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a seascape with ships on the water, seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon separates the sky from the sea, with various masts and sails. The brushstrokes appear detailed, adding texture to the scene. The color scheme is mainly gray, creating a moody atmosphere. Rocks are visible in the water, while ships form patterns in the distance. Some ships emit smoke. The composition includes a surrounding etching, adding visual complexity to the marine scene.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14.8 x 19.3 cm (5 13/16 x 7 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Arcana Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals in a confrontational scene. The image shows a figure kneeling with hands clasped in prayer, surrounded by others who appear to be engaged in aggressive actions. Some of these figures hold stones, with a few positioned to toss them. The setting indicates an open area with scattered stones on the ground. In the background, there is a structure resembling a medieval castle, featuring towers and flags, which adds a dramatic and tense element to the composition. The figures display exaggerated expressions and gestures in a style reminiscent of historical artworks.

artworks.title: Hagar Consoled by an Angel (from a painting by Castiglione) and Three Heads of Old Men (from a painting by Ricci of Jesus and the Adultress)
artworks.artist: Jean Claude Richard de Saint-Non after Jean-Honoré Fragonard (after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione and Sebastiano Ricci)
artworks.medium: etching (counterproof) reworked in brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.7 x 13.1 cm (7 3/8 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two separate drawings. In the upper section, a woman is seated in a flowing robe with her head turned to the right and her arm extended towards a child. Above her is an angelic figure with wings reaching down towards the woman. The background is a soft wash. Below, there are three men's heads in profile facing right, each with distinct features and headgear. The lower section also contains a signature and a handwritten annotation.

artworks.title: Waterfalls in a Mountain Forest
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and gray ink over graphite on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image features a detailed view of a rocky landscape, with trees and foliage obscuring the horizon. The painting showcases a watercolor technique, blending colors to depict textures in the rocks and trees. The color palette consists mainly of earth tones, with hints of teal and orange providing highlights. The trees and leaves are intricately rendered, contributing to the overall complexity of the scene.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features intricate, swirling lines and shapes forming an abstract composition around central text. The shapes resemble mythical creatures and natural forms, with the upper section resembling a scalloped shell adorned with leaves and floral motifs. Angelic figures or cherubs are integrated into the design, with winged forms flowing downward. A serpentine form coils at the bottom, resembling a snake. The composition blends elements from the animal kingdom and botanical ornaments into a harmonious abstract depiction.

artworks.title: View of Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)
artworks.description: This painting shows a view of a city, seen across a reflective body of water. The buildings in the distance are tall, with columns, arches, and large domed roofs. They are mostly painted in pale shades of pink, cream, pale yellow, and pale green.  In front of them, colorful boats and gondolas float on the water, some in brighter shades of blue, red, yellow, and black. The water below reflects all of these colors in a soft blend. Colorful dots on the boats suggest passengers sitting or standing on them. The sky is pale blue and filled with fluffy white clouds. Some white birds fly over the water near the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Christchurch Gateway, Canterbury
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a medieval-style gateway. The image shows a detailed, stone facade with Gothic architectural elements, including carvings and pillars. There are a smaller doorway and a larger arched entrance within the stone wall. A cobblestone street is in front of the gateway, with a building on the right side with a bay window and signs reading "Banks Draper." The sepia tones and contrasts accentuate the textures of the stone and light and shadow play across the architectural details.
